description:
There is an uncommitted change to spec/dns_cache_spec.cr:

  diff --git a/spec/dns_cache_spec.cr b/spec/dns_cache_spec.cr
  @@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
   require \"spec\"
  +require \"./support/crest_http_client_test_helpers\"
   require \"../src/fetcher\"

  describe Fetcher::CrestHttpClient do
    ...

The spec references a debug_* set of helpers on CrestHttpClient that
exist in spec/support/crest_http_client_test_helpers.cr:

  - debug_get_cached_dns
  - debug_clear_dns_cache
  - debug_verify_dns_rebinding
  - debug_allow_redirect?
  - debug_check_ssrf
  - debug_validate_redirect_target
  - debug_seed_dns_cache
  - debug_extract_redirect_url

The spec itself does not actually use most of these - it only calls
debug_clear_dns_cache, debug_get_cached_dns, and debug_verify_dns_rebinding.

The require line should not land on its own. Fold it into the DnsCache
extraction ticket, where the spec will be rewritten to test the new
Fetcher::DnsCache class directly, and the helper file will be split
or replaced.

Action:

  1. Do NOT commit the require line on its own.
  2. As part of fetcherc-tbk child #1 (DnsCache extraction):
     - Move the DNS-specific debug_* helpers to
       spec/support/dns_cache_test_helpers.cr.
     - Rewrite spec/dns_cache_spec.cr to instantiate Fetcher::DnsCache
       directly, not Fetcher::CrestHttpClient.
     - Drop the redirect/SSRF debug_* helpers from the new file (they
       belong to the RedirectPolicy extraction).
  3. Verify spec runs green after the extraction lands.
title: Fold uncommitted dns_cache_spec.cr helper require into DnsCache extraction
